description: This Java class 'DefaultAutoCloseableSlf4jLogger' provides a wrapper around SLF4J Logger, offering additional features such as MDC management, thread safety considerations, and auto-closeable behavior for resource management. It implements the 'AutoCloseableSlf4jLogger' interface, enabling MDC entries to be set, removed, and automatically cleaned up upon closing.

classes.name: DefaultAutoCloseableSlf4jLogger
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, auto-closeable wrapper around an SLF4J Logger that manages MDC entries locally and attempts to handle concurrent modifications gracefully.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DefaultAutoCloseableSlf4jLogger given an SLF4J Logger, ensuring the logger is not null.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the underlying SLF4J logger.

methods.name: isTraceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if trace level logging is enabled.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a trace message if tracing is enabled, after attempting to sync MDC entries.

methods.name: tryToPutLocalMdcToActualMdc
methods.description: Attempts to copy local MDC entries to the actual MDC, handling concurrent modification exceptions.

methods.name: putLocalMdcToActualMdc
methods.description: Copies local MDC entries into SLF4J's MDC.

methods.name: handleConcurrentModificationException
methods.description: Logs a warning when concurrent modifications to the MDC are detected.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a correlation ID in MDC entries, returning the same logger instance for method chaining.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID MDC entry.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or removes an MDC entry depending on whether the provided value is null.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes a specific MDC entry by key.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Removes all local MDC entries from the actual MDC and clears local entries, handling exceptions.
